text:
mike_infra: Onboarding: new tenant 'atlas-ai' needs a VNet in Switzerland North (switzerlandnorth). Two subnets (mgmt + compute). Compute will run A100 80GB instances — initial fleet 3 nodes (want 1 spare) so please request GPU quota of 4. Also need NAT gateway with HA public IPs and extra SNAT ports. Subscription: 00000000-0000-0000-0000-atlas000. Ping @emma_cloudops @sara_ops

emma_cloudops: Thanks @mike_infra — quick clarifying q: do they need PrivateLink to our blob storage or will they use public endpoints? Also which exact A100 SKU (v4/v3)?

mike_infra: They want PrivateLink for staging blob access. GPUs are A100 80GB (Standard_ND96asr_A100_v4). Region = switzerlandnorth. Public IPs: 2 (active + failover). Also request increase in available SNAT ports — workload is bursty during training checkpoints.

sara_ops: For Azure, SNAT port exhaustion is a frequent hit. We'll request multiple Public IPs on the NAT gateway and increase IP count. Suggest subnet sizing: compute subnet as /22 to avoid host limits.

alex: Paste subscription + tenant IDs and I'll open the support case. Also include a 12-month growth forecast to justify raising quotas.

mike_infra: Subscription: 00000000-0000-0000-0000-atlas000
Tenant: 11111111-2222-3333-4444-tenant
Quick az command we'll include for the case:
````
az vmss create --name atlas-gpu-ss --resource-group atlas-rg --image Canonical:UbuntuServer:18_04-lts:latest --vm-sku Standard_ND96asr_A100_v4 --instance-count 3
````
(we'll explain it's for a GPU VMSS with A100s)

emma_cloudops: Good. For PrivateLink you need a delegated subnet and storage account side configuration. I'll list required delegation and the exact service endpoint steps in the ticket.

sara_ops: :thumbsup: Starting the quota request for A100s, Public IPs, and SNAT port increases in switzerlandnorth. Note that A100s in this region are expensive — flagging cost to sales.

mike_infra: Cost covered by customer reserved commit for now. Also we need VNet peering with shared-services hub for DNS and logging. No VPN; plain VNet peering. Route table: 0.0.0.0/0 points to hub NAT.

alex: Reminder: peering count limits per subscription may require quota bumps too. I'll put that in the case.

niraj: Security note — restrict management subnet ingress to our bastion IPs only. Enable Microsoft Defender for Storage on blob accounts used over PrivateLink. Also ensure Private Link authorizations are in place.

deploy-bot: Support case created: case# AZ-2026-78321 (A100 quota + Public IPs + vNet peering limits + SNAT ports). Initial response ETA 24-48h.

mike_infra: Thanks @deploy-bot. I'll attach topology and perf numbers. Proposed CIDR plan: hub 10.0.0.0/22, atlas-vnet 10.4.0.0/22; mgmt 10.4.0.0/24; compute 10.4.4.0/22 (allows ~1021 hosts). Thoughts?

sara_ops: Compute /22 looks good. PrivateLink can use a /28 delegated range for the endpoint. I'll prepare recommended NSG rules and SNAT port forecasts.

emma_cloudops: I'll compile everything into the ticket and ping the account team for expedited review. Assigning follow-ups to @alex.

alex: On it — will update this thread when support replies. If they request perf benchmarks we'll include recent latency/throughput numbers from staging.

mike_infra: :thumbsup: thanks everyone, will wait for the support case update and then schedule the peering change window.
